name: New Lead — Supabase to Airtable + Resend

nodes.name: Supabase Webhook
nodes.notes: Supabase database webhook posts here on INSERT into audit_leads. Attach a Header Auth credential and have the webhook send the matching header.

nodes.name: Only New Leads
nodes.notes: Guards against future UPDATE/DELETE events on audit_leads turning into duplicate emails.

nodes.name: Airtable: Upsert Lead
nodes.notes: Upsert (not create) keyed on Supabase ID, so a webhook retry updates the existing row instead of creating a duplicate lead.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  from: $env.LEAD_NOTIFY_FROM,
  to: [$env.LEAD_NOTIFY_TO],
  reply_to: $('Only New Leads').item.json.body.record.email,
  subject: `New audit lead: ${$('Only New Leads').item.json.body.record.name} — ${$('Only New Leads').item.json.body.record.business}`,
  text: [
    'New consultation request',
    '',
    `Name:       ${$('Only New Leads').item.json.body.record.name}`,
    `Business:   ${$('Only New Leads').item.json.body.record.business}`,
    `Email:      ${$('Only New Leads').item.json.body.record.email}`,
    `Website:    ${$('Only New Leads').item.json.body.record.website || '—'}`,
    `Bottleneck: ${$('Only New Leads').item.json.body.record.bottleneck}`,
    '',
    `Submitted:  ${$('Only New Leads').item.json.body.record.created_at}`
  ].join('\n')
}) }}

nodes.name: Resend: Notify Me
nodes.notes: Attach a Header Auth credential: name 'Authorization', value 'Bearer re_your_key'. Plain text body on purpose — lead fields are attacker-controlled, and text can't carry injected markup.
